game.name: Minecraft (Classic)
game.rules:
# Rules

- All runs require video proof and must be submitted on YouTube (if you need an exception please let us know)
- Splicing, speeding up video, etc aren't allowed. The only forms of editing that are allowed are adding an intro or outro, adding background music and voiceover.
- Scroll wheel binding isn't allowed.
- Autoclickers aren't allowed.
- Glitches aren't allowed.
- Usage of spawn teleporting (pressing R) is counted as an input and only allowed if it is the first input.
- Only 1 Mouse binding allowed. (Ex: Left click only.)
- All runs require world generation to be shown. This includes clicking the "Generate New Level" button. (Added 12/06/20)
- We only accept runs played in 0.0.23a_01. You are allowed to play this version in the java launcher or on classic.minecraft.net.
- As of 7/16/2022, all runs require the taskbar to be shown. Any current runs will remain as is.
- As of 10/16/2023, you are not allowed to remap keys to left or right click. This ties into a previous rule.

# Timing

- Timing starts at first input and ends depending on the category.

# Extras

- Looking around counts as a first input
- Selecting items in your inventory counts as a first input

categories.name: Reach Bedrock
categories.rules:
Reach bedrock as fast as possible. Timer starts on first input, ends when bedrock directly under you is visible.


**New Rule as of 7/16/2022**

All runs under 2 seconds require sound of mouse clicks or a handcam aside the video. Runs that were performed before this rule change will not be affected by this rule.

categories.name: Place All Blocks
categories.rules: Place all the blocks as fast as possible. Timer starts on first input & ends when all blocks (Including inventory blocks) are placed.

categories.name: Build Limit
categories.rules: Timer starts on first input, ends when height limit block is placed (There's no warning for height limit)

categories.name: Destroy A Tree
categories.rules:
Destroy a whole tree as fast as possible. Timer starts on first input, ends when the whole tree is destroyed. This includes the leaves and logs/wood.

##New rule as of 4/13/2021##

Top 10 runs require handcam or mouseclicks. Any run in the top 10 past this date without it will be rejected.

categories.name: Meme Categories
categories.rules:
These are a selection of meme categories.

Please make sure you make the guidelines for the Main Rules when running your selected meme category.

categories.name: Find & Break All Natural Blocks
categories.rules:
Timer starts on first input, ends when the final block is broken. The only blocks that you need to mine/break are blocks that can naturally generate and are mineable/breakable. 

This includes:
- Grass Block
- Dirt Block
- Wood/Log
- Leaves
- Sand
- Gravel
- Stone
- Coal ore
- Iron ore
- Gold ore

Blocks you placed yourself do not count

categories.name: Reach Closest Border
categories.rules: Timer starts on first input & ends when border is touched

categories.name: All Borders
categories.rules:
Time starts on first input & ends when the last border is touched

**The use of teleporting back to spawn will not be tolerated**

categories.name: Minerals
categories.rules: Time starts on first input, ends when specified mineral is broken

categories.name: All Limits
categories.rules:
Reach bedrock, height limit, and all four borders as fast as possible. Timer starts on first input, timer ends either when

- Bedrock is seen
- Last block to height limit is placed
- Last Border is touched

categories.name: 9 Of Each Ore
categories.rules:
Timer starts on first input, ends when the final ore is broken. Get 9 of each ore. 

You need to break/mine:
- Coal Ore
- Iron Ore
- Gold Ore

values.name: Break Dirt
values.rules:
Break dirt as fast as possible. Time starts first input and ends when dirt is broken.

If you have a run where you don’t look around at all and break a dirt block it will default to 0.001.

Of course we will check.

values.name: Build an L
values.rules: Build a capitalized L as fast as possible, must be at least 4 blocks tall, 3 blocks wide.  Time ends when final block is placed.

values.name: Reach Bedrock (With Autoclicker)
values.rules: Reach Bedrock as fast as possible. The use of autoclickers is allowed, in this category only tho. Time starts first input and ends when bedrock is visible.

values.name: Build A House
values.rules: Timer starts on first input, ends when the final block of the house is placed (House needs to have a space at least 1x1 wide, 2 blocks tall, walls, a roof and a space for a door. Walls do not need to be 2 blocks tall, as long as it prevents you from going outside)

values.name: Reach Lava
values.rules: Get into lava as fast as possible. Timer starts on first input, ends when lava is touched.

values.name: Reach Water
values.rules: Get into water as fast as possible. Timer starts on first input, ends when Water is touched.

values.name: Mine a Chunk
values.rules:
Create a one chunk (16x256x16) region ONLY down to the top level of lower floor as fast as possible. Time starts on first input and ends when the final block is broken.

Chunk is allowed to be filled with water.
